title: Northwind launches Picker 3 for mixed-product warehouses
text:
Rotterdam, 3 November 2026. Northwind Robotics today launched Picker 3, its third-generation piece-picking robot.

Picker 3 handles up to 1,100 picks per hour in tests at customer sites, compared with 800 for the previous model. A new two-finger gripper lets it pick items in soft packaging, such as bagged clothing and pouches, which earlier models could not handle reliably.

Picker 3 is available to order now. First deliveries are planned for January 2027. Existing customers can upgrade under their current lease.

"Soft packaging was the most common reason a customer could not automate a station," said Joris Aalbers, chief technology officer of Northwind Robotics. "Picker 3 removes it."
